whole_interface_change: Production A1 keeps the top-5 SLOTS and merges duplicate slots of the same ID into one atom with accumulated mass (2/5, 3/5, ...). Both new arms always deliver 5 DISTINCT image IDs with mass 1/5. Any difference vs A1 therefore belongs to the whole interface (candidate source + duplicate handling), not to the source alone.
shortage_handling: As production (search returns None when < K ID-bearing slots: batch direction skipped, counted t2i_no_proto). Additionally, if any row still has < 5 unique IDs after the backfill rule, the batch direction is skipped the same way and counted (cnt_t2i_cs_short_rows, cnt_t2i_cs_skipped_batches). Without source exclusion all rows share one unique-ID set, so this can only occur when the whole bank has < 5 distinct images.
